from fnmatch import fnmatchcase


def matches(path: str, pattern: str) -> bool:
    # Match the supplied public route segment by segment, so wildcards never cross "/".
    path_segments = path.split("/")
    pattern_segments = pattern.split("/")
    if len(path_segments) != len(pattern_segments):
        return False
    return all(fnmatchcase(segment, part) for segment, part in zip(path_segments, pattern_segments))
EOF

def test_badge_route_does_not_match_nested_folders():
    service = AssetService({
        "/teams/west/badge.png": b"PNG",
        "/teams/west/drafts/badge.png": b"draft",
    })
    assert service.fetch("/teams/west/badge.png") == (200, b"PNG")
    assert service.fetch("/teams/west/drafts/badge.png")[0] == 403
    assert not service.is_public("/teams/west/drafts/badge.png")
EOF
